data.explanation: This is an invoice for carpentry work (a built-in oak shelf) that was completed on 26 January 2026. You need to transfer the total amount of €1,487.50 to the workshop's account by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. If you miss it, the workshop could send a reminder or charge late-payment interest, though none is mentioned here. Keep this invoice for your tax records, since the labour portion of craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be deducted in your German tax return.
data.tax_note: Labour costs for craftsman/tradesperson services (Handwerkerleistungen), such as the on-site installation fee listed here, can typically be claimed as a tax deduction under §35a EStG in the German income tax return; keep this invoice and proof of the bank transfer as evidence.
